description: This file defines internal interfaces for testing hooks related to the Orleans runtime system target, including methods for retrieving silo information, storage and stream provider status, and grain unregistration.

classes.name: ITestHooks
classes.description: An internal interface providing asynchronous method signatures for testing hooks related to silo and provider diagnostics, grain management, and silo status retrieval.

classes.name: ITestHooksSystemTarget
classes.description: An internal interface extending ITestHooks and ISystemTarget, representing a system target interface with testing hooks capabilities.

methods.name: GetConsistentRingPrimaryTargetSilo
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the primary target silo address for a given key in the consistent ring.

methods.name: GetConsistentRingProviderDiagnosticInfo
methods.description: Retrieves diagnostic information about the consistent ring provider.

methods.name: HasStorageProvider
methods.description: Checks asynchronously whether a storage provider with the specified name exists.

methods.name: HasStreamProvider
methods.description: Checks asynchronously whether a stream provider with the specified name exists.

methods.name: UnregisterGrainForTesting
methods.description: Unregisters a grain for testing purposes, given its GrainId.

methods.name: GetApproximateSiloStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves an approximate mapping of silo addresses to their statuses.
